## 4. COMMON ISSUES & TROUBLESHOOTING  
### Issue: "AMS Service Unavailable"  
**Symptoms:** API returns 503, IBP shows error  
**Steps:**
```
1. Check service status
kubectl get pod -n production | grep ams

2. Check logs
kubectl logs -f deployment/ams | tail -50

3. Check database connection
curl https://api.firstuk.bank/ams/health/db

4. If DB connection issue
Verify PostgreSQL running: systemctl status postgresql@main
Verify connection pool: psql -U postgres -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='firstuk_prod';"

5. Restart service
kubectl rollout restart deployment/ams
kubectl rollout status deployment/ams --timeout=5m

6. Verify recovery
curl https://api.firstuk.bank/accounts -H "Authorization: Bearer [token]"
(Should return account list)
```

raw_entities.name: AMS Service Unavailable
raw_entities.description: A system outage affecting the AMS (Account Management Service) API, characterized by 503 service unavailable responses and error display in the IBP interface. The incident may stem from service pod failures, database connectivity issues, or connection pool exhaustion.
context: Check service status kubectl get pod -n production | grep ams
Verify PostgreSQL running: systemctl status postgresql@main
Restart service kubectl rollout restart deployment/ams

raw_entities.name: Service Status Check
raw_entities.description: Initial diagnostic step to verify the operational status of AMS service pods in the production Kubernetes cluster. Executed as the first troubleshooting action when AMS Service Unavailable is reported.
context: kubectl get pod -n production | grep ams

raw_entities.name: Service Log Review
raw_entities.description: Examination of the most recent 50 lines of AMS deployment logs to identify error messages, stack traces, or operational anomalies contributing to the outage.

raw_entities.name: Database Connection Health Check
raw_entities.description: API-based health check to verify connectivity between the AMS service and its PostgreSQL database backend. A successful response indicates the database connection is operational.

raw_entities.name: PostgreSQL Service Verification
raw_entities.description: System-level verification that the PostgreSQL database service is running on the main instance. Executed when database connectivity issues are suspected.
context: Verify PostgreSQL running: systemctl status postgresql@main

raw_entities.name: Database Connection Pool Analysis
raw_entities.description: Query of PostgreSQL system tables to count active database connections for the firstuk_prod database. Identifies connection pool exhaustion as a potential root cause.
context: Verify connection pool: psql -U postgres -c "SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='firstuk_prod';"

raw_entities.name: AMS Service Restart
raw_entities.description: Kubernetes-based restart of the AMS deployment to recover from transient failures or resource exhaustion. Includes rollout status monitoring with a 5-minute timeout.

raw_entities.name: Service Recovery Verification
raw_entities.description: API call to the accounts endpoint with bearer token authentication to confirm that the AMS service has recovered and is returning account data successfully.
